item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00306","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C07","C15","C13"],"selected_candidate_label":"C07","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C07 plausibly supplied the central drafting template. Both communications address a nationally important industrial labor deadlock after unsuccessful negotiation or mediation and propose the same distinctive machinery: continued work under existing collective-bargaining terms for a fixed period, appointment of a three-member public fact-finding board, a shorter deadline for its report, recommendations for a fair and equitable settlement, and a request that the parties accept or cooperate with the proposal. The child expands this framework with post-report mediation and express freedom to reject the recommendations. C15 and C13 are closely related later stages of the same steel-dispute procedure and share some language and machinery, but they are less complete templates for the child's initial proposal.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"That work be performed and normal production maintained for a period of 70 days ... under the terms and conditions last agreed upon by the Union and the employers","parent_excerpt":"continue work and operations under the terms of the collective bargaining agreements now in effect for a period of sixty days","explanation":"Both propose a fixed cooling-off period of continued production under existing contractual terms."},{"child_excerpt":"a Fact-Finding Board ... consist of three citizens representing the public ... empowered to inquire into any and all facts and circumstances relating to the current dispute","parent_excerpt":"a Board consisting of three public members to investigate and to inquire into the issues in dispute","explanation":"This is the same distinctive three-member public fact-finding mechanism."},{"child_excerpt":"make its report, including findings and recommendations, within 60 days ... outlining the procedures and the grounds for a fair and equitable settlement","parent_excerpt":"report to me thereon within forty-five days ... with their recommendations to the parties as to fair and equitable terms of settlement","explanation":"Both require a board report before the work-continuation period ends and use closely matching fair-and-equitable-settlement language."},{"child_excerpt":"I urge your acceptance in the National interest","parent_excerpt":"I earnestly request all parties to the dispute to accept this proposal","explanation":"Both conclude by asking labor and management to accept the proposed voluntary procedure."}]}
